decisions.reason: Only mentioned on the website, close to the established offer with little visible commitment and no central role in the announced digital and energy direction, so under escalation of commitment it is relatively easy to drop.
Energy management system aligns with the announced direction toward energy recovery and digital networking, making the firm likely to persist despite limited website presence.
Having its own webpage signals strong public commitment, and the firm will likely continue to justify and support the product rather than write off the investment.
